title: Law 4.4 Probe: R^512 Sparse-Mask Prior & 1e-5x / 1e4x Scale Shock
intuition: Dual-part Law 4.4 probe combining (A) a 64-mode 10%-observed R^512 bounded manifold (P=1600, RMSNorm critic) and (B) an extreme 1e-5x-scaled 4-mode GAN hit by a transient 1e4x scale spike and mode shift at step 200.
failure_mode: Scale-dependent step floors or non-resetting EMA denominators either freeze at 1e-5x data scale or lock up permanently after the step-200 1e4x shock spike; sparse 10% masks break dense prior updates.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence diagnostic probe testing scale-free settling and shock recovery.
